verdict.rationale: Figma's official MCP server documents a 'write to the canvas' capability that lets agents create and modify native Figma content, generate FigJam diagrams into new or existing files, and push captured live UI into files. Beyond MCP, the Plugin API grants read and write access to file contents, and the Variables REST API supports creating, updating and deleting variables. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agent writes via MCP work reliably; the core REST API for file content is read-only, so write access depends on MCP and plugins.
